description: Additional managed rules beyond the pre-migration ESLint inventory, including post-migration Modern Web Guidance coverage. tests/managed-config/additions.test.ts checks levels and scope. New web guidance checks begin at warning; contextual browser behavior remains subject to review.

@sarj/prefer-coordinated-react-state.note: Complete repeated setter groups with a local record witness; review ownership without an automatic fix.

@sarj/no-oxlint-directive.note: keep one suppression spelling; Standards separately enforces the required suppression policy

@eslint-react/web-api-no-leaked-resize-o.findings: 6 across the four leak rules, Platform only, one real leak

import/no-anonymous-default-export.note: the React Compiler checks analyze only named functions, so an anonymous default component goes unchecked; the default allowCallExpression keeps `export default defineConfig(...)` valid, and a Workers `export default { fetch }` object needs a named constant

import/no-mutable-exports.note: catches a reassigned `export let`, a live binding that importers see change; prefer-const and no-var also report never-reassigned `let` and `var` exports

import/no-self-import.note: resolves `.js` specifiers to TypeScript sources, tsconfig paths and `.` from an index module; a CommonJS `require` of the file itself goes unreported

typescript/promise-function-async.note: off in JSX files because React 19 ReactNode includes Promise, so inferred component and render-callback returns read as promises; --fix adds async only where every return is a Promise, turning synchronous throws into rejections

typescript/strict-boolean-expressions.findings: Platform 44 (4 real bugs, all mixed-type unions)
typescript/strict-boolean-expressions.note: Nullable strings, numbers, booleans and any stay allowed; mixed-type unions and nullable enums report. The upstream defaults report 723 Platform conditions with no bug in a 40-hit sample.

prefer-object-spread.note: Modern construct: object spread over Object.assign({}, ...).

prefer-numeric-literals.note: Modern construct: binary, octal and hexadecimal literals over radix parsing of constants.

no-object-constructor.note: Modern construct: object literals over Object().

unicorn/no-new-array.note: Modern construct: replace ambiguous new Array(value) with [value] for one element or Array.from({ length: value }) for allocation.

unicorn/numeric-separators-style.note: Modern construct: group long numeric literals with separators.

unicorn/prefer-modern-dom-apis.note: Modern construct: modern DOM replacement and insertion methods.

@sarj/jsx-no-forbidden-nesting.findings: Platform 0 (902 current files; 2,886 changed file versions)
@sarj/jsx-no-forbidden-nesting.note: HTML parser repairs React reports as hydration errors, plus content-model nesting in one visible JSX tree.

promise/no-new-statics.note: covers JS files the type check skips; TS7009 reports the same call in type-checked files

promise/no-return-in-finally.note: covers JS, JSX, TSX and syntax-only config files, where typescript/strict-void-return is off or has no types

promise/valid-params.note: covers JS files the type check skips and zero-argument then(), catch() and finally() calls TypeScript accepts; reports those calls on any receiver

typescript/no-unsafe-class-instance-assi.note: Detect structurally compatible objects that bypass class construction; begin as a warning.

unicorn-js/prefer-options-parameter.note: Recommend consolidating optional positional arguments before an existing options object; no automatic API rewrite.

unicorn-js/require-spread-parentheses.note: Autofix complex spread arguments while preserving comments and formatter convergence.

unicorn-js/prefer-regexp-exec.note: Safely fix non-global regexp matches in JavaScript and syntax-only configuration; the native type-aware owner handles typed source.
